title: NeoMundi Integrations
description: Integration library attaching NeoMundi behavioural measurement to the hook a host framework already provides — LangChain, Langfuse, LiteLLM, Microsoft Agent Framework, MLflow, the OpenAI Agents SDK and OpenTelemetry. Each integration carries an evidence level that continuous integration computes from a committed proof rather than reading from a declaration, together with its explicit limitations.
